verdicts.reason: Both share the same serious flaws: the 'PICK YOUR SOUND' eyebrow is moved to the far right after the headline, which breaks the reading order. The price labels are swapped (Obsidian Buds $179 sits under the headphones, Obsidian One $349 sits beside a scrap of the earbuds case). The earbud case is cut down to two floating dots, the headphone band is cropped at the top, and an orphaned platform ellipse floats at the right edge. A at least left-aligns the headline with the subhead and price row. B's bigger headline sticks out about 40px left of the subhead, so its left edge is ragged, and it crowds the headphone graphic.
